top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is a concrete invention (magic-wavelength trapping of many atoms in the Lamb-Dicke regime) that nature has confirmed: independent laboratories reach and compare clocks at the 10^-18 level and resolve gravitational redshift over millimetres. It is mature after more than twenty years, distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system prizes, and the invention-and-realization citation to Katori and Ye is a clean, defensible allocation, so it clearly beats awarding nothing.
